Under the new NSE and SEBI retail algo trading rules, independent ("tech-savvy") traders using broker APIs must now register a Static IP address—even if they use AI tools like Claude to write their own trading code.
While these rules apply to all brokers, traders who use exchange-empanelled platforms for strategies like Time-Based Straddles (TBS) can rely on the platform\'s servers, whereas independent API coders must set up and maintain their own static IPs.
